checkpoints.label: Checkpoint 1
checkpoints.title: Separate the recorded fields from interpretation
checkpoints.guidance: Begin with the catalogue layer. Retain the stable record ID and read the raw date, place, names, and classification fields as recorded values—not as conclusions.

checkpoints.label: Checkpoint 2
checkpoints.title: Check how the point reached the map
checkpoints.guidance: A precise-looking marker can still rest on coarse or provisional geography. Check the coordinate tier, precision, source, and stated uncertainty before drawing spatial conclusions.

checkpoints.label: Checkpoint 3
checkpoints.title: Follow the APRO publication route
checkpoints.guidance: Open the reviewed archive route and note what the precision badge actually promises. A highlighted viewer page is a finding aid; verify the scan before quoting or attributing a claim.

checkpoints.label: Checkpoint 4
checkpoints.title: Compare an independent publication family
checkpoints.guidance: Now follow a Data-Net route for the same catalogue record. Distinct publication families are useful for source comparison, but source counts do not by themselves establish independence or truth.

checkpoints.label: Checkpoint 5
checkpoints.title: Carry the method into comparison
checkpoints.guidance: Add three reviewed dossiers to the research workspace. Compare dates, locations, source families, link counts, and evidence-status labels while leaving missing fields visible.
